title: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker and former Imperial trainee who searches the Multiverse for the missing emperor and the man with the metal arm.

entities.name: Eiko Shizuki
entities.description: Kaito's sister, now an Imperial advisor, who tells him Tameshi was seen with the man with the metal arm.

entities.name: Tameshi
entities.description: Kaito's moonfolk Futurist friend and mentor, who is mortally wounded in the warehouse and names Tezzeret before dying.

entities.name: Himoto
entities.description: The tanuki-shaped kami who sparked Kaito's planeswalking and who takes the form of a drone and mask.

entities.name: Man with the metal arm
entities.description: The planeswalker Kaito saw in Kyodai's temple, whom Kaito is hunting in connection with the emperor's disappearance.

entities.name: Chrome monster
entities.description: A chrome-bodied, bird-faced, clawed creature in the warehouse who speaks of excising weakness and eradicating evidence; this page does not name it.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: The name Tameshi whispers with his last breath, in answer to how he knew the man with the metal arm.

entities.name: The Emperor of Kamigawa
entities.description: The missing ruler of Kamigawa, Kaito's friend.

entities.name: Light-Paws
entities.description: Kaito's former teacher, now busy preventing a rebellion at court.

entities.name: Risona
entities.description: A leader whose supporters, including the Asari Uprisers, grow bolder while the throne is empty.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: The guardian kami who has not been herself since the emperor vanished.

entities.name: Kami of Street Vendors
entities.description: A dough-faced kami at a Towashi food stall that wants noodles.

entities.name: Imperials
entities.description: The ruling order of Kamigawa, led in part by Eiko and Light-Paws.

entities.name: Futurists
entities.description: Technologists of Otawara who believe experimenting with technology is the way forward.

entities.name: Asari Uprisers
entities.description: A rebel group in the Sokenzan mountains growing bolder and supporting Risona.

entities.name: Reckoners
entities.description: Criminal henchmen who work with the chrome monster in the warehouse.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: The neon-lit city of Kamigawa.

entities.name: Undercity
entities.description: The surface district beneath Towashi's skyscrapers where Tameshi's secret meeting takes place.

entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: The Futurists' floating city in the clouds.

entities.name: Docks warehouse
entities.description: A dockside warehouse in the Undercity where a monster, Reckoners, and Tameshi conduct illicit experiments.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane threatened by a rebellion and a new menace.

events.summary: Kaito, now a planeswalker, scouts Towashi with his tanuki drone Himoto and spots Imperial samurai outside an apartment with a window left ajar.
events.quote: Kaito nudged the drone skyward toward the height of the nearby buildings.

events.summary: Kaito sneaks into the apartment and meets his sister Eiko, who invited him by leaving the window open.
Eiko explains Risona's supporters and the Asari Uprisers grow bolder as the throne stays empty.
events.quote: The Asari Uprisers grow bolder every day.

events.summary: Kaito and Eiko argue over technology and balance, Kaito insisting technology levels the playing field.
Using a noise suppressor, Eiko tells Kaito that Tameshi was seen meeting a man with a metal arm in the Undercity.
events.quote: Tameshi was seen meeting with a man in the Undercity. A man with a metal arm.

events.summary: Kaito decides to trust his sister enough to investigate and spy on his best friend.
events.quote: Kaito believed in his sister enough to follow the trail.

events.summary: For weeks Kaito tails Tameshi on Otawara and finds he is hiding secret deals and a secret project.
events.quote: And he'd watched the unregulated drones leave the compound and head straight for the Towashi Undercity.

events.summary: Kaito disables a security camera and breaks into Tameshi's compound while Tameshi is away.
events.quote: No camera would see him now

events.summary: In Tameshi's office Kaito finds a coded message to meet in the Undercity that night and a blueprint of a strange device.
events.quote: The meeting was happening tonight, and soon

events.summary: Kaito tracks Tameshi to the Undercity docks and sends Himoto into a warehouse laboratory.
events.quote: Silently, she flew toward the warehouse.

events.summary: Through the drone Kaito sees a chrome monster directing Reckoners to load specimens, with something screaming like a kami inside a container.
A Reckoner smashes the beakers and the warehouse is set ablaze, destroying evidence as the vehicle leaves.
events.quote: threw it against the rest of the glass with force.

events.summary: Kaito finds Tameshi mortally wounded by a metal arm, bleeding in the corner of the burning warehouse.
events.quote: The fabric of his robes had been slashed across the middle, clawed by a metal arm.

events.summary: Tameshi admits that lying to Kaito was his worst mistake.
events.quote: "I—I've made so many mistakes. But lying to you was the worst of them."

events.summary: Tameshi dies after whispering the name Tezzeret.
events.quote: "Tezzeret," Tameshi whispered like he was breaking a spell. And then he was gone.

events.summary: Kaito takes Tameshi's lab key card and leaves the blazing warehouse.
events.quote: he reached into his friend's pocket and removed the key card to his lab.

relations.note: friend and mentor over the years
relations.quote: He'd been both a friend and a mentor over the years.

relations.note: the kami who sparked Kaito and takes drone and mask form
relations.quote: she represented the kami who had changed Kaito's life forever.

relations.note: Reckoners load and destroy materials at its command
Tameshi's wound was clawed by a metal arm
